description: Repository-grounded release gate for current UAMS architecture and operating rules.

queries.query: What remains the authoritative shared memory record?
Which engine remains responsible for semantic vector search?

Why is Redis unnecessary for the one-machine deployment?
How does normal retrieval treat archived and superseded memories?
Should agents save raw conversations or distill reusable atomic knowledge?
How long may a Markdown wall of text be before a structural break is required?
Which command starts both databases, migrates the schema, starts host services, and waits for readiness?
What are the required begin and end calls in the MCP task lifecycle?
Which infrastructure services run locally in Docker on the first deployment?
Where do canonical user and agent profiles live, and which database materializes their current facts?
How does entity resolution normalize aliases while preserving display names?
Which graph claim statuses may influence normal retrieval ranking, and why can candidate claims not boost results?
Can a historical search include archived or superseded revisions?
Which durable store selects the current supported profile fact and handles conflict resolution?
What is the exact name of the Qdrant collection that stores the new chunk vectors?
